hypothesis: The C25 training-only-selected frozen H3 state-action interaction critic ranks successful first-action chunks above failed alternatives on fresh C27 source episodes and beats an action-only shortcut.
single_variable: The candidate adds the frozen live INT8 H3 layer-49 state feature interaction to the executed 32-step action chunk; the action-only arm, data, pairwise objective, optimizer budget and fresh validation split remain fixed.
parent_baseline: C25 all 32 groups are now training-only and C27 contributes 58 training groups; the only untouched evaluation data are C27's 20 source-episode-disjoint validation groups, including four mixed groups and 12 sortable pairs.

references.title: FACT: A Failure-Aware Causal Transformer for World Action Models

architecture.paper: A causal transformer predicts future consequences and action value.
architecture.upstream_code: Candidate actions are scored for best-of-N selection.
architecture.local: The D0 action parent and live INT8 H3 are frozen; only an isolated linear pairwise head over H3-state/action interactions is fitted.
evidence: scripts/h3wam/train_c28_fresh_causal_action_critic.py
architecture.rationale: The available controlled outcomes support a small falsifiable critic, not end-to-end FACT reproduction.

data.paper: Successful and failed rollouts supervise action value.
data.local: Four alternative first actions are executed from each bit-exact simulator state with identical continuation seed schedules; C27 source episodes are split-disjoint and frozen before outcome inspection.
evidence: /mnt/h3-wam/eval/c27-expanded-causal-dataset-v1/COMPLETED
/mnt/h3-wam/eval/c28-fresh-critic-v1/c27_dataset.pt
data.rationale: The local labels are directly observed closed-loop successes under controlled first-action interventions.

action.paper: Generated action tokens are valued before execution.
action.local: The exact decoded 32-step environment-domain action chunk that was executed is scored.
evidence: scripts/h3wam/prepare_c27_causal_critic_dataset.py
action.rationale: Using the executed chunk removes action-decoding and clamp ambiguity.

objective.paper: Value/cost supervision distinguishes successful and failed candidates.
objective.local: Balanced within-state pairwise logistic loss orders every success/failure action pair.
evidence: scripts/h3wam/train_c26_causal_action_critic.py
objective.rationale: Pairwise ordering is identifiable without requiring globally calibrated success probabilities.

optimization.upstream_code: World, action and value objectives are jointly trained.
optimization.local: The C25 train-group LOO-selected configuration is frozen at 10 full-pair steps, learning rate 0.03, weight decay 3.0 and projection seed 20260815; all parent parameters remain frozen.
evidence: /mnt/h3-wam/eval/c26-causal-critic-v1/train_group_loo.json
optimization.rationale: No C27 validation outcome was used for configuration selection.

evaluation.upstream_code: The value head selects candidates during rollout.
evaluation.local: C28 first requires pair accuracy, top-1 success, action-only margin, shuffled-label margin and permutation significance on four untouched C27 mixed validation groups.
evidence: scripts/h3wam/train_c28_fresh_causal_action_critic.py
evaluation.rationale: A closed-loop N=1 versus N=4 canary is authorized only if this fresh mechanism gate passes.

decision.rationale: The preregistered C27 data gate passed and the C28 configuration was selected exclusively from C25 training groups; one fresh held-out confirmation is authorized.

result.interpretation: The H3 interaction fits training pairs better than action-only (65/72 versus 53/72) but reverses to 6/12 versus 7/12 on fresh episodes. More epochs on this representation are not justified; candidate-conditioned consequence learning needs a new source-episode split.
result.next: Stop static state-action ranking and best-of-N. Freeze C27 as consumed exploratory evidence; collect new source episodes before testing an action-conditioned dynamics/consequence route.
